title: Where to Eat in Berlin by Neighbourhood - Quick Summary
items: **Choose one Berlin neighbourhood for each dinner night.** A compact evening is usually better than crossing the city for a saved restaurant list.
**Kreuzberg or northern Neukölln works when food is the main event.** Use a transit station as your return anchor and keep a nearby backup.
**City West is the low-friction choice after Messe Berlin or a west-side day.** Savignyplatz and Kantstraße give you dinner plus a short walk without a second itinerary.
**Prenzlauer Berg suits a slower final evening.** It is better for a sit-down meal and a walk than for a forced late-night plan.
**Book the meal that matters; leave the rest flexible.** Check current opening hours, menus and tables on the day rather than trusting a fixed restaurant list.
